---
name: audit-repo
description: "Audit Gate-OS against the repository, tests, CI, docs, security, and licenses; produce evidence rather than assumptions."
---

Act as Orchestrator. Delegate read-only checks to QA, security, and license agents. Compare every public claim with repository evidence, report what is real/stubbed/broken, count tests and coverage, inspect CI, and write `docs/AUDIT.md` plus prioritized `docs/ROADMAP.md`. Stop at Checkpoint 0.
